import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int l = sc.nextInt();
            k += l;
        }
        System.out.println(k / n);
        sc.close();
    }
}
